what: The section is pinned (sticky) with one sentence standing in the center, and behind it the card row (cards 12vw square, 1vw gap, 105vw margin at both ends) is pushed left by its horizontal overflow. Scroll length is half the overflow, so the cards pass twice as fast as the scroll (no easing curve). While each card travels from 90% on the right of the screen to 10% on the left, even cards arc upward and odd cards downward, up to 48% of the screen height (38% on portrait screens) plus 50% of the card’s own height, then come back (power1.inOut yoyo). Each tilts the opposite way from a random ±3°, and swells to 1.4 scale and back (back.inOut(3) yoyo), so the cards drift past in waves around the sentence

options.rise: Bend height in landscape view (share of screen height), default .48
options.tall: Bend height on portrait screens, default .38
options.grow: Scale when swelling at center, default 1.4
options.pace: Scroll length share against overflow, default .5

note: Card size is --fx-card (default 12vw). With reduced motion, the cards go under the sentence as a wrapping grid. The original pulls up 25% overlapping under the previous section’s ”See All” and pulls the next section up 15%, but the part does not overlap
